title: 2575. Find the Divisibility Array of a String

examples.explanation: There are only 4 prefixes that are divisible by 3: "9", "99", "998244", and "9982443".
There are only 2 prefixes that are divisible by 10: "10", and "1010".

hints: We can check if the numeric value of the prefix of the given string is divisible by m by computing the remainder of the numeric value of the prefix when divided by m.
